title: SweepANN: A GPU-Accelerated Large-K Approximate Vector Search for Drug Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.27306v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: DrugCLIP places small molecules and protein pockets in one space, turning genome-wide drug discovery into large-K retrieval by vector proximity. A campaign fixes over 20K pockets in advance for one library of over 500M molecules. Each pocket keeps K = 500K candidates, 0.1% of the collection, versus 100 in ANN benchmarks. Missed hits never get tested, so mean recall must reach 99% relative to exact search. Large answers make IVF probe every list holding a result and graph search track K or more candidates, so costs grow with K. On our CPUs and GPUs, neither index family reaches the target without losing most of its edge over scanning.   SweepANN partitions compressed vectors across GPUs and scans each resident partition. One matrix multiplication scores each block for a whole query batch, reading it once. Several plans perform the K-dependent selection and merging of each query's K answers, each returning an exact top-K under compressed

translated_title: SweepANN：面向药物发现的GPU加速大K值近似向量搜索
translated_abstract: DrugCLIP将小分子和蛋白质口袋置于同一向量空间中，把全基因组范围的药物发现转化为基于向量邻近性的大K值检索任务。一次筛选活动会针对一个超过5亿分子的化合物文库预先固定超过2万个蛋白质口袋。每个口袋需保留K = 50万个候选结果（约占整个集合的0.1%），而典型的ANN基准测试中K仅为100。由于漏掉的候选永远不会被实际测试，因此相对于精确搜索，平均召回率必须达到99%。如此巨大的答案规模导致IVF索引必须探测每一个包含结果的列表，图搜索则必须追踪K个以上的候选，使得计算成本随K线性增长。在我们的CPU和GPU平台上，这两类索引家族都无法在保留其相对暴力扫描优势的前提下达到目标。SweepANN将压缩后的向量划分到多个GPU的显存中，并逐一扫描每个驻留分区。一次矩阵乘法即可为整个查询批次对每个数据块进行评分，每个块仅需读取一次。系统采用多种执行方案来完成与K相关的候选选择与合并操作，每种方案都能在压缩表示下返回精确的top-K结果。
tldr: SweepANN通过将压缩向量分区驻留在GPU上、利用单次矩阵乘法对整个查询批次批量评分并优化K相关候选的合并策略，解决了传统IVF和图索引方法在大K值（每个查询需50万候选、99%召回率）药物筛选场景下成本随K增长而失效的问题。
en_tdlr: SweepANN enables GPU-accelerated large-K approximate vector search for drug discovery by partitioning compressed vectors across GPUs, scoring entire query batches with single matrix multiplications, and overcoming the K-dependent cost scaling that renders IVF and graph-based ANN indexes impractical when each query requires 500K candidates at 99% recall.
